name: Warlock
equipment: (a) a light crossbow and 20 bolts or (b) any simple weapon
(a) a component pouch or (b) an arcane focus
(a) a scholar's pack or (b) a dungeoneer's pack
Leather armor, any simple weapon, and two daggers

1.name: Pact Magic
1.desc: Few slots, all of your highest level, back on a short rest; spells known, CHA.

2.name: Eldritch Invocations
2.desc: Two invocations, more by level (see table); swap one on each warlock level.

3.name: Pact Boon
3.desc: Blade (summoned proficient magical weapon, bind a magic one), Chain (Find Familiar with imp, pseudodragon, quasit or sprite forms, it attacks in your place), Tome (Book of Shadows with three cantrips from any list) or Talisman (+d4 to a failed check, prof bonus/long rest).

11.name: Mystic Arcanum
11.desc: One 6th-level spell castable once per long rest without a slot; a 7th at 13th, 8th at 15th, 9th at 17th.

13.name: Mystic Arcanum
13.desc: One 6th-level spell castable once per long rest without a slot; a 7th at 13th, 8th at 15th, 9th at 17th.

15.name: Mystic Arcanum
15.desc: One 6th-level spell castable once per long rest without a slot; a 7th at 13th, 8th at 15th, 9th at 17th.

17.name: Mystic Arcanum
17.desc: One 6th-level spell castable once per long rest without a slot; a 7th at 13th, 8th at 15th, 9th at 17th.

20.name: Eldritch Master
20.desc: 1 min plea to your patron restores all Pact Magic slots; once per long rest.

actions.name: Fey Presence
actions.desc: Action: creatures in a 10 ft cube from you, WIS save DC {dc:CHA} or charmed or frightened (your pick) until your next turn ends

actions.name: Misty Escape
actions.desc: Reaction when you take damage: invisible and teleported up to 60 ft until your next turn or you attack or cast

actions.name: Dark Delirium
actions.desc: Action: a creature within 60 ft, WIS save DC {dc:CHA} or charmed or frightened in an illusion for 1 minute (concentration)

1.name: Fey Presence
1.desc: Action, 10 ft cube: WIS save or charmed or frightened until your next turn ends; once per short rest.

6.name: Misty Escape
6.desc: Reaction when damaged: invisible and teleport 60 ft until your next turn or you attack or cast; once per short rest.

10.name: Beguiling Defenses
10.desc: Immune to charm; reaction to turn a charm attempt back, WIS save or charmed 1 min or until damaged.

14.name: Dark Delirium
14.desc: Action, creature within 60 ft: WIS save or charmed or frightened in an illusory realm for 1 min (concentration), ends on damage; once per short rest.

1.name: Bonus Cantrips
1.desc: Light and Sacred Flame, not counted as known.

1.name: Healing Light
1.desc: Pool of 1 + level d6; bonus action heal a creature within 60 ft spending up to CHA mod dice; long rest.

6.name: Radiant Soul
6.desc: Radiant resistance; your radiant or fire spells add CHA to one damage roll against one target.

10.name: Celestial Resistance
10.desc: After each rest, temp HP equal to level + CHA, and up to five others half level + CHA.

14.name: Searing Vengeance
14.desc: Instead of a death save, regain half your HP max and stand; chosen creatures within 30 ft take 2d8 + CHA radiant and are blinded this turn; once per long rest.

1.name: Tentacle of the Deep
1.desc: Bonus action: 10 ft spectral tentacle within 60 ft for 1 min, melee spell attack 1d8 cold (2d8 at 10th) and -10 ft speed; bonus action to move and strike again (prof bonus/long rest).

6.name: Oceanic Soul
6.desc: Cold resistance; fully submerged, you and other submerged creatures understand each other.

6.name: Guardian Coil
6.desc: Reaction: reduce damage to a creature within 10 ft of the tentacle by 1d8 (2d8 at 10th).

10.name: Grasping Tentacles
10.desc: Evard's Black Tentacles known, once free per long rest; casting it grants temp HP equal to level and damage can't break its concentration.

14.name: Fathomless Plunge
14.desc: Action: you and up to five willing creatures teleport up to 1 mile to a body of water you have seen; once per short rest.

actions.name: Dark One's Blessing
actions.desc: You dropped a hostile creature to 0 HP: temporary HP

actions.name: Dark One's Own Luck
actions.desc: Add the roll to one of your checks or saves, after seeing the d20

actions.name: Hurl Through Hell
actions.desc: On a hit: the target tours the lower planes until your next turn ends (non-fiends take the damage)

1.name: Dark One's Blessing
1.desc: Dropping a hostile creature to 0 HP: temp HP equal to CHA + warlock level (min 1).

6.name: Dark One's Own Luck
6.desc: Add a d10 to a check or save after seeing the roll; once per short rest.

10.name: Fiendish Resilience
10.desc: After a rest pick a damage type to resist, except from magical or silver weapons.

14.name: Hurl Through Hell
14.desc: On a hit, the target vanishes through the lower planes until your next turn ends and takes 10d10 psychic unless a fiend; once per long rest.

actions.name: Entropic Ward
actions.desc: Reaction: an attack on you rolls with disadvantage; if it misses, your next attack on that creature has advantage

1.name: Awakened Mind
1.desc: Telepathy with any creature within 30 ft that understands a language.

6.name: Entropic Ward
6.desc: Reaction: disadvantage on an attack against you; if it misses, advantage on your next attack against it; once per short rest.

10.name: Thought Shield
10.desc: Your thoughts can't be read unless you allow it; psychic resistance, and psychic damage dealt to you is mirrored on its source.

14.name: Create Thrall
14.desc: Action, touch an incapacitated humanoid: charmed until Remove Curse or a new thrall, with telepathy on the same plane.

1.name: Hexblade's Curse
1.desc: Bonus action curse within 30 ft for 1 min: + prof bonus damage, crits on 19-20, heal level + CHA if it dies; once per short rest.

1.name: Hex Warrior
1.desc: Medium armor, shields, martial weapons; after a long rest use CHA for attacks with one non-two-handed weapon (all pact weapons with Pact of the Blade).

6.name: Accursed Specter
6.desc: A humanoid you slay rises as a specter under your command until your next long rest, with temp HP half your level and + CHA to attacks; once per long rest.

10.name: Armor of Hexes
10.desc: Reaction when the cursed target hits you: d6, on 4+ it misses.

14.name: Master of Hexes
14.desc: When the cursed target dies, move the curse to another creature within 30 ft (no healing then).

1.name: Expanded Spell List
1.desc: Extra spells on your warlock list, by genie kind.

1.name: Genie's Vessel
1.desc: Tiny vessel and focus: once per long rest hide inside for up to 2 x prof bonus hours; once per turn a hit deals + prof bonus damage of your genie's type.

6.name: Elemental Gift
6.desc: Resistance to your genie's damage type; bonus action 30 ft fly and hover for 10 min (prof bonus/long rest).

10.name: Sanctuary Vessel
10.desc: Bring up to five willing creatures into the vessel; 10 min inside counts as a short rest with + prof bonus to Hit Die healing.

14.name: Limited Wish
14.desc: Action: the effect of any 6th-level-or-lower, 1-action spell without requirements; once per 1d4 long rests.

1.name: Expanded Spell List
1.desc: Extra spells on your warlock list.

1.name: Form of Dread
1.desc: Bonus action, 1 min: 1d10 + level temp HP, immune to fear, once per turn a hit forces a WIS save or frightened (prof bonus/long rest).

6.name: Grave Touched
6.desc: No need to eat, drink or breathe; once per turn change a hit's damage to necrotic, +1 die in Form of Dread.

10.name: Necrotic Husk
10.desc: Necrotic resistance (immunity in Form of Dread); reaction at 0 HP to stay at 1, dealing 2d10 + level necrotic to chosen creatures within 30 ft, then one exhaustion level; once per 1d4 long rests.

14.name: Spirit Projection
14.desc: Action, up to 1 h (concentration): your spirit leaves your body, resists weapon damage, flies and passes through objects, casts conjuration and necromancy without most components; once per long rest.

1.name: Among the Dead
1.desc: Spare the Dying, advantage on saves against disease; undead targeting you directly must pass a WIS save or pick another target.

6.name: Defy Death
6.desc: Regain 1d8 + CON HP on a successful death save or when you stabilize someone with Spare the Dying; once per long rest.

10.name: Undying Nature
10.desc: No need to breathe, eat, drink or sleep; you age one year per ten.

14.name: Indestructible Life
14.desc: Bonus action: regain 1d8 + level HP and reattach severed parts; once per short rest.
